reason: No fixed version: the advisory covers every release up to 4.0.7, the latest. Only the test and build tools use it here (jest through micromatch, anymatch and jest-util at 2.3.2; node-gyp's tinyglobby at 4.0.4), on the repository's own patterns; the app's production dependencies hold none (npm audit --omit=dev).
